sourceText: 修复这个问题：在别的项目下运行时，它去 packages/main/package.json 中找对应的版本号以记录到证据中。
normalizedOutcome: External project causal evidence records the executing PoS CLI version regardless of business manifests or cwd.
acceptanceClaim: The recorded causal identity toolVersion equals the executing CLI version with missing, malformed, and conflicting business manifests.
